0 grammar ::= remember stmtseq
1 grammar ::= remember stmtseq sideff
2 grammar ::= GRAMEXPR optexpr
3 grammar ::= GRAMBLOCK block
4 grammar ::= GRAMBARESTMT barestmt
5 grammar ::= GRAMFULLSTMT fullstmt
6 grammar ::= GRAMSTMTSEQ stmtseq
7 grammar ::= GRAMSUBSIGNATURE subsigguts
8 bare_statement_block ::= block cont
9 bare_statement_expression ::= sideff PERLY_SEMICOLON
10 bare_statement_null ::= PERLY_SEMICOLON
11 bare_statement_utilize ::= KW_USE_or_NO startsub BAREWORD optlistexpr PERLY_SEMICOLON
12 block ::= PERLY_BRACE_OPEN remember stmtseq PERLY_BRACE_CLOSE
13 block ::= PERLY_BRACE_OPEN remember stmtseq sideff PERLY_BRACE_CLOSE
14 empty ::=
15 remember ::=
16 stmtseq ::= empty
17 stmtseq ::= stmtseq fullstmt
18 fullstmt ::= barestmt
19 barestmt ::= bare_statement_block
20 barestmt ::= bare_statement_expression
21 barestmt ::= bare_statement_null
22 barestmt ::= bare_statement_utilize
23 sideff ::= expr
24 cont ::= empty
25 startsub ::=
26 optsiglist ::= empty
27 subsigguts ::= optsiglist
28 expr ::= listexpr
29 listexpr ::= listexpr PERLY_COMMA
30 listexpr ::= listexpr PERLY_COMMA term
31 listexpr ::= term
32 termbinop ::= term ASSIGNOP term
33 term ::= termbinop
34 term ::= scalar
35 term ::= star
36 term ::= hsh
37 term ::= ary
38 term ::= arylen
39 term ::= THING
40 term ::= amper
41 optlistexpr ::= empty
42 optlistexpr ::= listexpr
43 optexpr ::= empty
44 optexpr ::= expr
45 amper ::= PERLY_AMPERSAND BAREWORD
46 scalar ::= PERLY_DOLLAR
47 ary ::= PERLY_SNAIL
48 hsh ::= PERLY_PERCENT_SIGN
49 arylen ::= DOLSHARP
50 star ::= PERLY_STAR BAREWORD
